fieldValues.title: Where should a graph view live?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (1. People need to see what links to what), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. A lens layout in the editor: the set, the one thing, and what links to it, drawn as a graph.
- B. A Composition section or renderer, so a graph can be part of a document.
- C. A new presentation object of its own, beside compositions.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Which reading tasks a graph view serves and how the Map is used today: there are no usage numbers.
fieldValues.next_action: List the tasks behind the owner's requests to see links (vignettes 2941f51a, 35e35dd2, the lenses assessment) and match each to an option.
